correctness.rationale: Hölder duality gives full width 2||u||_q; strict norm inequalities classify the only extrema. In spherical tangent coordinates, widths have uniform leading forms at axes [(2/q)∑|z|^q for q<2; negative ||z||² for q>2] and diagonals [(q−2)f_q||z||²]. Exact tangent-ball volumes and chart multiplicities prove all four probabilities and marked limits. Uniform expansion in q at 2 yields H(U)/2, whose lower/upper local forms are r²log(1/r²) and log d−2r². Deterministic checker replay passed 256 tests. No numerical test is offered as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural sharp distributional classification of random directional widths across ℓp anisotropy, including all local angular shapes, exact constants and a logarithmically corrected singular Euclidean limit. The tail powers and constants directly quantify how many random viewing directions are needed to witness nearly extremal widths, and the entropy limit explains failure of commuting order of limits. Not a generic single-parameter substitution or a precomputed table.
